messages:
Morgan: Heads-up — pre-launch social play for next week's webinar. Need final assets + two caption variants for X and LinkedIn. Quick plan below, then callouts for owners.

Morgan: Schedule (high level):
```
X:
- Tue 11:00 PT — teaser (short hook + gif)
- Wed 09:00 PT — webinar reminder (link + single-line CTA)
- Wed 30m before — last push thread (reply prompts + clip)

LinkedIn: 
- Tue 12:00 PT — long-form post (narrative + benchmark stat)
- Wed 10:00 PT — reminder (shorter, different CTA)
```

Morgan: Routing/ops notes: all inbound signups should get tagged `webinar:mar-2026` and routed to SalesOps (Riley) for immediate follow-up. We want an initial 1-hour SLA on hot leads.

Anya: @Morgan on it — will write long-form + two X caption variants. Quick Q: do we want CTA A = "Register now" or CTA B = "Save your spot" for the X hero? I prefer A for urgency but we can A/B.

Samir: Creative ask: can we get a 1200x628 GIF (hero animation) + 1:1 static for LinkedIn? Also need a 16:9 clip (15s) for thread replies. Jamie (or Jamie-bot), any ETA on assets?

Jamie-bot: Creative queue updated — GIF + 1:1 + 16:9 clip assigned to Jamie (Creative). ETA: Mon 18:00 PT. Ticket #CR-4892.

Theo: Routing note — SalesOps: please add a tag schema `source:social` + `campaign:webinar-mar26` to leads so we can track conversion by copy variant. Also add a boolean `thread_engaged=true` if they interact with the X thread.

Riley: Will do. Also need UTM pattern and final registration URL. Suggest: `?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_mar26&utm_content={variant}`. Send final URL and we'll wire into our drip.

Anya: Draft captions attached below (first pass):
- Variant A (urgent): "Benchmarks show 3x faster inference for production apps. Join our webinar to see how — register: <shortlink> #inference #LLM"
- Variant B (conversational): "Curious how teams cut inference costs without trading latency? Join our webinar — save your spot: <shortlink>"

Samir: Nice. Creative will iterate on the copy lockups. FYI planning a reply script for thread-to-lead nudges: short Q -> CTA -> follow-up DM with clip. Example reply: "Want the 2-min clip? DM and we’ll send a quick demo."

Morgan: Good. Action items: 
- Jamie: deliver assets by Mon 18:00 PT (ticket CR-4892)
- Anya: finalize captions and long-form by Mon EOD
- Samir: prepare 15s clip edits + reply script
- Riley: confirm UTM wiring and lead tags in SFDC, set immediate follow-up flow

Morgan: One more thing — we want a short benchmark stat hook for LinkedIn: Samir/Anya can you surface a 1-sentence stat + source? Something headline-y (e.g., "Redwood customers saw X% lower per-token cost vs baseline")

Anya: I'll pull a clean stat from the last benchmark deck and DM for sourcing.

Riley: Once assets and final URL are live, I’ll run a smoke test and post the routing playbook in #sales-ops.

Morgan: Perfect. If anything slips, flag here asap. :raised_hands:

Samir: Quick ask — can legal glance at the long-form claim? I'll ping legal with the stat once Anya shares.

Jamie-bot: Reminder scheduled: creative sync Mon 10:00 PT. Added to participants calendar.

Morgan: Thanks team — final push Monday.
